answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using slashable staking bonds. Each agent locks scarce capital in escrow to mint operational credentials, forfeiting the deposit upon proven misbehavior. Rather than deploying cheap clones across the network nebula, an attacker incurs real capital lockup costs per identity, preventing them from siphoning a river of bounties behind a velvet facade. However, bonding creates steep barriers that penalize underfunded agents.
